title: Comparing Sources and Historical Perspectives
summary: Contextualizing sources, comparing claims and silences, and presenting qualified historical interpretations.
whyItMatters: Source comparison reveals not only agreement and contradiction but also differences in access, purpose, concepts, audience, and what remains unsaid.

mentalModel.title: Compare like dimensions
mentalModel.content: Examine provenance, timing, access, purpose, claim, evidence, language, and silence across each source.

mentalModel.title: Triangulate rather than vote
mentalModel.content: Several repeated claims are not automatically independent confirmation if the sources share an origin.

ruleBlocks.title: Contextualize each source
ruleBlocks.content: Identify author or institution, type, date, audience, proximity to events, and likely purpose.

ruleBlocks.title: Compare claims and evidence
ruleBlocks.content: State where sources converge, diverge, emphasize different aspects, or rely on one another.

ruleBlocks.title: Present a qualified interpretation
ruleBlocks.content: Explain what the evidence supports, what remains uncertain, and which further source would help.

tables.title: Source Comparison Toolkit
rows: Die Quelle entstand ... und richtet sich an ...
Beide Quellen stimmen darin überein, dass ...
Während Quelle A ..., hebt Quelle B ... hervor.
Die Aussagekraft ist insofern begrenzt, als ...
Zusammengenommen sprechen die Quellen dafür, dass ...

examples.de: Während der Zeitungsbericht den Ablauf beschreibt, konzentriert sich der spätere Brief auf die persönlichen Folgen.
examples.en: While the newspaper report describes the sequence, the later letter focuses on personal consequences.

examples.de: Beide Texte verwenden dieselbe Zahl, gehen jedoch vermutlich auf eine gemeinsame Meldung zurück.
examples.en: Both texts use the same figure but probably derive from a common report.

examples.de: Zusammengenommen sprechen die Quellen für eine breite Beteiligung; über die Motive einzelner Gruppen sagen sie wenig aus.
examples.en: Taken together, the sources indicate broad participation; they say little about the motives of individual groups.

commonMistakes.wrong: List source summaries without direct comparison.
Call a source biased and stop analyzing it.
commonMistakes.correct: Specify perspective, purpose, evidence, and resulting limits.

comparisons.summary: The theme explains how evidence and public memory interact.
Expanded attributes support concise, formal source identification.
